# PhotoCut Studio

> Free, no-registration image tools that run 100% in your browser. Background removal with on-device AI (WebAssembly + ONNX), plus convert, compress, resize, color tools, EXIF/metadata removal and icon generation. Your photos are never uploaded to any server — all processing happens locally on the user's device.

PhotoCut Studio is a client-side web app. Unlike most online image tools, it does not send images to a server: the AI cutout model (u2netp via onnxruntime-web) and a Rust/WebAssembly GrabCut engine run in the browser. This makes it private by design — useful for client work, documents, or personal photos — and free with no account, no watermark and no usage limits. Available in Spanish, English and Portuguese.

## Tools
- [Remove background](https://www.photocutapp.com/en/tools/remove-background.html): automatic AI cutout plus keep/erase brushes; export transparent, solid color or a new background.
- [Change background](https://www.photocutapp.com/en/tools/change-background.html): replace the background with a color or another image.
- [Compress and convert images](https://www.photocutapp.com/en/tools/compress-image.html): PNG, JPG and WebP with a quality control, showing the output size before download.
- [Resize an image](https://www.photocutapp.com/en/tools/resize-image.html): change size in pixels or by percentage, keeping aspect ratio.
- [Color palette and HEX from an image](https://www.photocutapp.com/en/tools/color-palette-from-image.html): extract dominant colors, read HEX, check WCAG contrast, generate CSS/Tailwind scales.
- [View and remove EXIF metadata](https://www.photocutapp.com/en/tools/view-exif-metadata.html): see camera, date and GPS data a photo carries and download a copy with metadata stripped.
- [Blur the background (portrait effect)](https://www.photocutapp.com/en/tools/blur-background.html): keep the subject sharp and blur the background.
- [Color blindness simulator](https://www.photocutapp.com/en/tools/color-blindness-simulator.html): preview a design as someone with color blindness sees it.
- [All tools](https://www.photocutapp.com/en/tools/)
